szoveg_eredeti:
In addition to everything you mentioned @dens, please factor in that you inspired a whole generation of entrepreneurs (including me) by showing them that:
- you can build a cool startup from NYC
- you can build something fun and that you care about
- you can persevere & stick to trying to build what you're excited about no matter what (it's the journey, not the destination!)

Thank you Dennis & team!
